overview: The Market Tier is the commercial heart of Ka Vethan, where lineage‑assigned vendors trade goods under Praesertum oversight.
history: Established during early Akhevan expansion to centralize civic commerce.
Resonance‑regulated trade halls were added to stabilize void‑arcane influence.
Appraisal chambers formalized economic valuation through arcane analysis.
Praesertum licensing ensured trade aligned with civic doctrine.
Modern Market Tier remains the busiest district in Ka Vethan.
hooks: A trade hall experiences resonance instability.
A vendor reports void‑tainted goods entering circulation.
An appraisal chamber malfunctions during valuation.
A Praesertum directive alters market licensing rules.
